sum: A fully modernized, modular, EE/EET-compatible rebuild of Weimer's classic Solaufein Romance mod, with a content-aligned 5-component layout and working bark playback.
no: Install after ValenEE for the cross-mod interjections in Component 10. Must be installed before eet_end, cdtweaks, and stratagems.
ic: Hard conflict with legacy (non-EE) Solaufein Romance mods. Install after ValenEE for cross-mod interjections.

co.no: Required. Joinable NPC plus spawn triggers, ToB fate spirit summon, core dialogue, and SoA-side content. Includes explicit CRE field writes, full 12-slot bark restoration with working playback, known-spells compaction, and the pdialog.2da registration.
SoA Chapter 6 story branch. Bodhi abducts Solaufein and the player can restore him via the Temple Ruins ritual. Requires Component 10.
Recommended if you play ToB. Interjections, epilogue variants, and the Moonblade auto-return script. Requires Component 10 and the Throne of Bhaal expansion.
Optional high-difficulty ToB challenge encounter with six custom foes. Self-contained. Requires Component 10 and ToB.
Optional. Independent patches (Korgan loop fix, Viconia LOVETALK 46 fix, multiplayer kick-out script, UHMER store, projectile fixes). Does not require Component 10.

conflicts.reason: Cannot coexist with older legacy non-EE versions of the Solaufein Romance package.

advisories.reason: Solaufein's Component 10 conditionally compiles cross-mod interjections if valenj.dlg is present at install time. Install Valen before Solaufein so the interjections are included.

rec.tip: Install after Valen for the cross-mod interjections in Component 10.

cl.m: Added to catalog as modernized EE/EET rebuild; 5-component layout with content-aligned ordering.
